'''October 2001 Mastic tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mastic, NY on 27 October 2001. [[John Curran]] won it. It is known from Sam Diamond's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3080">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-28-mastic-ny-10-27-01-number-1d3080/ mastic-ny-10-27-01-number-1], DeckTech (Sam "AgentSD" Diamond, 28 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-28-mastic-ny-10-27-01-number-1d3080/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Mastic, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[John Curran]]
